id.meaning: Identifier from the accept route path; the selected ledger row must be a pending house-link-up.

schema.meaning: When present and non-null, the old request's schema must equal caduceus.notifications.v1.

names.meaning: Unique .home.arpa names; absent or null uses the candidate's names. Each label is 1–63 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen.

dry_run.meaning: Only the literal true selects the portal-admit plan instead of the write. All other JSON values, including null, proceed as non-dry-run; the existing notification schema declares boolean or null.

schema.meaning: Schema on local success and refusal; a failed portal-admit receipt is passed through whole instead.

ok.meaning: Success or refusal of the composite operation.

id.meaning: Accepted ledger row ID on successful mutation.

state.meaning: Ledger state after a successful admission.

staff.meaning: The in-process portal-admit receipt on success or incomplete convergence; a failed receipt instead becomes the whole top-level return.

attempted.meaning: The planned admission has not been attempted.

argv.meaning: The planned portal-admit argument vector on dry run.

child_portals.meaning: The child-portal plan on dry run; actual child results are nested in staff on success.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms also include arbitrary firstMissingSignal or error text from the returned portal-admit receipt, which is passed through whole.
